blocks.en: We now extend the result to more general domains.
blocks.zh: 现在将结果推广到更一般的区域.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $\Omega$ is of class $C^K$ and $\partial\Omega$ is bounded. Then, for any integer $k$ with $0\leq k\leq K$, there exists a bounded operator\[E:H^k(\Omega)\to H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)\]such that $Eu|_{\Omega}=u$. Moreover, $E$ can be chosen independent of $k$.
blocks.zh: 假设 $\Omega$ 为 $C^K$ 类, $\partial\Omega$ 有界. 那么对满足 $0\leq k\leq K$ 的任意整数 $k$, 存在有界算子\[E:H^k(\Omega)\to H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)\]使 $Eu|_{\Omega}=u$. 此外, 可选取与 $k$ 无关的 $E$.
blocks.label: thm:smooth-domain-sobolev-extension

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Note that we only require $\partial\Omega$ to be bounded, not necessarily $\Omega$. For example, the theorem includes the case of exterior domains.
blocks.zh: 注意, 只要求 $\partial\Omega$ 有界, 而不要求 $\Omega$ 必定有界. 例如, 该定理包括外区域的情形.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We cover $\partial\Omega$ with small neighborhoods $U_j$ such that within each $U_j$ there is a $k$-diffeomorphism which maps $\partial\Omega\cap U_j$ to a subset of $\{x_m=0\}$. Let $\{\phi_j\}$ be a partition of unity subordinate to the covering $\{U_j\}$ of $\partial\Omega$. Let $u\in H^k(\Omega)$. Then, for each $j$, $\phi_ju$ can be extended to all of $\mathbb{R}^m$ by using the transformation theorem and Theorem~\ref{thm:halfspace-sobolev-bounded-extension}. More precisely, let $\bm{\Phi}_j$ be the diffeomorphism on $U_j$ which maps $\partial\Omega\cap U_j$ to a part of the plane $x_m=0$. Then $(\bm{\Phi}_j^{-1})^*(u\phi_j)$ (extended by zero outside $\bm{\Phi}_j(U_j)$) is in $H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$ and can be extended to a function in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$; let us call the extended function $v_j$. We multiply $v_j$ by a function $\psi_j\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ which has support in $\bm{\Phi}_j(U_j)$, but equals one in $\bm{\Phi}_j(\operatorname{supp}\phi_j)$. Then $\bm{\Phi}_j^*(v_j\psi_j)$ is in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ with support contained in $U_j$. Hence each $\phi_ju$ can be extended. Finally $u-\sum_j\phi_ju$ has compact support in $\Omega$, hence it can be extended by zero (see Problem~\ref{ex:compact-support-zero-boundary-sobolev}).
blocks.zh: 用小邻域 $U_j$ 覆盖 $\partial\Omega$, 使每个 $U_j$ 内都有一个 $k$ 阶微分同胚, 将 $\partial\Omega\cap U_j$ 映到 $\{x_m=0\}$ 的一个子集. 设 $\{\phi_j\}$ 为从属于 $\partial\Omega$ 的覆盖 $\{U_j\}$ 的单位分解. 设 $u\in H^k(\Omega)$. 那么对每个 $j$, 可利用变换定理和 Theorem~\ref{thm:halfspace-sobolev-bounded-extension}, 将 $\phi_ju$ 延拓到整个 $\mathbb{R}^m$. 更确切地, 设 $\bm{\Phi}_j$ 为 $U_j$ 上将 $\partial\Omega\cap U_j$ 映到平面 $x_m=0$ 的一部分的微分同胚. 那么 $(\bm{\Phi}_j^{-1})^*(u\phi_j)$ (在 $\bm{\Phi}_j(U_j)$ 外作零延拓) 属于 $H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$, 可延拓为 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中的函数; 将延拓所得函数记为 $v_j$. 用函数 $\psi_j\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 乘 $v_j$, 其支集位于 $\bm{\Phi}_j(U_j)$ 内, 但在 $\bm{\Phi}_j(\operatorname{supp}\phi_j)$ 中等于一. 那么 $\bm{\Phi}_j^*(v_j\psi_j)$ 属于 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 且支集包含于 $U_j$. 因而每个 $\phi_ju$ 都可以延拓. 最后, $u-\sum_j\phi_ju$ 在 $\Omega$ 中具有紧支集, 因而可以作零延拓 (见 Problem~\ref{ex:compact-support-zero-boundary-sobolev}).

blocks.en: The same result (with a much harder proof) holds if $\partial\Omega$ is Lipschitz rather than of class $C^K$.
blocks.zh: 若 $\partial\Omega$ 为 Lipschitz 而不是 $C^K$ 类, 同样的结果也成立 (但证明困难得多).
blocks.label: rem:lipschitz-domain-sobolev-extension
